// B2-1 (consumer cell c): a value module whose only Spinetab import is an
// inline type list. Under verbatimModuleSyntax (./tsconfig.json), Vite 8
// emits `import {} from "spinetab/sse"`, so the entry is in the module graph
// although the application never uses SSE as a value.
import { type SseFeed } from "spinetab/sse";

export function feedLabel(feed: SseFeed | undefined): string {
	return feed === undefined ? "polling" : "sse";
}
